name: Misari
source:
Misaris work with flowers creates beauty that soothes and inspires those around him.

He struggles to share his deeper emotions, retreating into perfectionism and isolation.

Shaped by a near-death experience and an emotionally distant upbringing, Misari devotes himself to his flower shop and private music, valuing beauty and stillness over the fast pace of life.
